0.original: Cahciua would guide you to the next zone.

24.original: Speak with the Asyle Volcane guard.

49.original: Upon our return, we must regale Gulool Ja with the heroic tale of Ser Otis Velona.

51.original: We still have a ways to go. Let's keep moving.

52.original: So far there appears to be no change with the Meso Terminal.

53.original: So let's take the opportunity to visit another zone: Asyle Volcane, in the northeast.

54.original: The place with the volcano, eh? And I suppose we're using the zip line again.

55.original: You know it. Like before, I'll take care of the guard at the Gate of Remembrance. Come, let's head back.

56.original: That's a fiery place indeed... I wonder what it's themed upon.

57.original: I must say, it saddens me to see the scenery change in our wake.

58.original: How can she be so carefree about everything...?

59.original: That volcano <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> isn't real, right? All that smoke pouring out is just part of the glamour?

61.original: Dauntless adventurers, I bid you welcome to Asyle Volcane, the sanctuary of the strong! Fight with courage and honor, that your legend may resound forevermore in the Arena of Valor!

62.original: <gulp> It's only an illusion... It's only an illusion...

63.original: What's this, now? Don't tell me you're afraid of the lava?

64.original: N-Not on your life! I-It isn't even real, is it?

65.original: Oh, definitely not. But don't take my word for it─jump in and see for yourself.

68.original: You can get to it via the caverns that run through the volcano.

69.original: I'll go on ahead and wait for you. Take care around the wildlife, now!

71.original: I'll explore alone. You needn't worry─I'll give the wildlife a wide berth.

72.original: Poor Erenville... He's still coming to terms with it.

73.original: You can hardly blame him. Let's leave him be for now.

74.original: Come on, let's get moving ourselves.

75.original: Right would seem to be the more direct path to the terminal, but I must say I'm curious about that building on the left.

76.original: The mechanical soldiers are as common here as they are in Solution Nine. I wonder how long ago they were created.

77.original: Looks like we have two paths to choose from. I thought I saw Cahciua heading left, though.

78.original: While that would seem to be a detour, I must say I'm rather curious about that round building.

79.original: Well, I'm always up for the scenic route. Let's follow after Cahciua and see what the building's about!

81.original: A round building with seating for spectators... Might this be a fighting arena?

83.original: Well now, look who came this way too. Great minds, as they say!

84.original: This appears to be a fighting arena. Is it also a recreation of an actual place?

85.original: In all likelihood. While I don't know the details, I understand such facilities were once common across the land.

86.original: Though it's closed at the moment, even Solution Nine has the Arcadion. It may well be a legacy of the past.

87.original: Anyway, it seems the next match is about to begin. As I've already spectated my fill, I will move on, but you ought to head inside for a look!

88.original: To think that Krile would actually meet her parents...

89.original: Miracles really do happen here... I'm happy for Krile.

90.original: Could it be that the system orchestrated this reunion as well...?

91.original: Forgive me... This is all so much to take in, I'm struggling to collect my thoughts.
